verdict.rationale: Jira is a SaaS product with a public REST API, so scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent is a fair axis to judge it on. The evidence pack never documents scoped API tokens, OAuth scopes, service accounts, or permission-limited credentials. The REST API, OpenAPI spec, MCP server and SAML/SSO items show API access and identity features but not credential scoping, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
